_help: Market Cap and FDV Calculator settings. presets: example tokens (made up) the visitor can load. bands: the one line explanation, picked by the percent of total supply already circulating (the first band whose maxCirculating is at or above it). {pct} is filled in.
marketCapLine: Market cap is what the tokens trading today are worth: price times circulating supply.
fdvLine: FDV (fully diluted value) is what every token would be worth at today's price once all are unlocked: price times total supply.

bands.line: Only {pct}% of tokens are out. Future unlocks could add a lot of selling pressure.
{pct}% of tokens are out. More than half are still to come, so watch the unlock dates.
{pct}% of tokens are out. Some unlocks remain, but most supply is already trading.
{pct}% of tokens are out. Almost everything already circulates, so there is little left to unlock.

tooMuch: Circulating supply can't be bigger than total supply. Check the numbers.
